answer: Make paid work payable only through a bonded identity: each agent locks earned POA that releases at the vertex of verified job completion. A raven-style randomized jury of non-kin agents audits finished jobs, and when it proves an identity belongs to a sybil ring, the bond burns. Spinning up clones then costs real stake per identity, while wharf-style quarantine holds the earnings of flagged identities for several epochs so mass-created accounts cannot cash out before detection.
